title: Close the pill gap on PR 219 by moving the list index onto the card's node
context: card-pill-reach made the card's node (_RenderPillReach in log_actions_pill.dart) grow 15 dp over the pill, but SliverList/ListView wrap each item in IndexedSemantics, a boundary node whose frame reaches only 12 dp (Today feed), 9 dp (day sheet) or 0 dp (first feed card) above the card. The pill's top 3-15 dp stays outside a reading-order ancestor, so the macOS VoiceOver pointer misses it and the phone check for 10.23 would still flag Edit and Delete.
options: Fix on PR 219: addSemanticIndexes false in the feed and day sheet, index carried by the card's growing node
Ship 219 as is and add a wave 3 Step
outcome: Owner chose: fix it on PR 219. The feed and day sheet lists stop adding per-item index nodes; the card's growing node carries the same indexInParent; the day sheet summary keeps its own index. Tests use the real feed and day sheet.
